description: This file implements an AST traverser to replace pow(x, y) calls with exp2(y * log2(x)) when y is a constant, working around an NVIDIA driver issue.

classes.name: RemovePowTraverser
classes.description: An AST traverser class that converts pow operations to exp2(y * log2(x)).

methods.name: IsProblematicPow
methods.description: Checks if a pow node has a constant exponent y.

methods.name: RemovePowTraverser::RemovePowTraverser
methods.description: Constructor initializing the traverser with a symbol table.

methods.name: RemovePowTraverser::visitAggregate
methods.description: Visits aggregate nodes to replace problematic pow calls.

methods.name: RemovePow
methods.description: Main function to perform the removal of pow calls in the AST.
